## History

Shirley declined a marriage proposal from [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), telling Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) during a summer vacation visit that she only viewed him as a friend. She later met a handsome student named Royal Gardner during a sudden downpour, after which he sent her roses and left her wondering if she had encountered her ideal prince. While accompanying [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting, Shirley met [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) and subsequently visited his home for tea to meet his mother. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she was shocked to learn that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever, spending a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for him before learning at dawn that he had survived the crisis.

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), [v3 ch.People P22](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0022), [v3 ch.People P26](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0026), [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), +10 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's bosom friend, though their early companionship faced obstacles when Diana's mother temporarily forced them apart. Despite this separation, they maintained a close bond by exchanging secret notes and eventually resuming their warm friendship. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has shared key milestones with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), from celebrating academic achievements to being the confidante who receives the news of Diana's engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), +15 more_

- Friend of — bosom friends forced apart by her mother  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as fierce academic rivals during their school days, competing closely for honors like the Avery Scholarship and top medals. Over time, their intense rivalry softened into subtle moments of quiet understanding and romance, such as after Miss Lavendar's wedding. Anne's feelings for him culminate in a night of deep distress when she realizes her profound love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while he is critically ill with typhoid fever.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), +13 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in schoolwork  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) is a chum living and working alongside others at the stone house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) collaborates closely with her to manage tasks at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), such as picking strawberries, tidying up after events, and helping prepare Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

- Comrade of — chums living and working together at the stone house (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends who frequently spend time together at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a supportive companion, offering to stay with her during low moments and helping coordinate her reconciliation with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assists with Miss Lavendar's garden wedding, she later confides in her about her personal life, admitting she refused Gilbert's proposal because she views him only as a friend.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), +19 more_

- Friend of — close friends and visitors (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is Anne's imaginative pupil, and she acts as his teacher and mentor at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their bond extends beyond the classroom as [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers her up with gifts of wild orchids, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits him outside of school hours. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is deeply distressed when news spreads that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is resigning her teaching post to attend college.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), +9 more_
